info.name: Bullish Trading Portfolio Margin Simulator API

items.docs:
Use Portfolio margin simulator to determine your margin requirements and risk levels based on your current portfolio balances. 
You can also append position details on top of your portfolio specifics to see simulated results.

params.name: includeExisting
params.description: When true, includes existing portfolio positions in the simulation. Defaults to false

items.docs:
Use Portfolio margin simulator to determine your margin requirements and risk levels based on your current portfolio balances.
You can also append position details on top of your portfolio specifics to see simulated results.
This endpoint supports running multiple simulations at the same time.
